scope: Controlled natural-text full-model offline replay with a finite real LMCache CPU L1. Not AgentX, GSM8K accuracy, HTTP serving, SSD/NVMe, or a concurrency performance benchmark. Separate immutable-capture microbenchmarks establish codec/transfer behavior; their rounds are nested samples within each process.

protocol.timed_steps: All first cold prefill, generation, saved KV encoding/D2H/publication and return requests. Publication drain included. Model load/JIT separate.
protocol.source: GSM8K train text for natural controlled histories only, not GSM8K accuracy or official AgentX.

measurement_notes.wall: Request windows include generation and publication drain. Trace wall additionally includes between-request harness work. Explicit initialization and final shutdown are excluded; lazy compilation inside a request remains included.
measurement_notes.token_metrics: TTFT/TPOT use engine timestamps; publication drain after the response is included in wall, not token latency.
measurement_notes.cache_hits: Total cached tokens combine GPU APC and external reuse. Restored external blocks are separately counted.
measurement_notes.traffic: RPC bytes count blob payload, including object-format overhead, not complete ZMQ/protocol wire bytes.
measurement_notes.timings: Host-observed operation sums can overlap or nest. put/get are complete call spans, not pure network or LMCache algorithm times. Queue/source-hold cannot be added to wall.
measurement_notes.statistics: Two fresh model processes per mode. Process medians are retained; no request-level pseudo-replication or confidence interval.
measurement_notes.output: Generated token differences are observations, not automatic evidence of codec loss. Bitwise KV checks use separate immutable roundtrips.

runs.timing_boundary: generate plus explicit publication drain per step; initial load/profile and final shutdown excluded

compression.raw_fallback_scope: aggregate K+V; raw baseline is not a compression fallback

memory.scope: native KV plus explicit codec/transfer/map buffers and source-derived descriptors; allocator/CUDA runtime outside the KV tensor budget

l1.occupancy_scope: L1 occupancy peak is sampled; RSS is process high-water mark; they are not summed with model-process peaks
